title: Plan GROUP BY COUNT(column) fast path
problem: The simple GROUP BY column aggregate fast path supported COUNT(*) but rejected COUNT(column), sending grouped non-null counting back to the generic aggregation path.
approach: Add CountColumn state to the existing simple GROUP BY column aggregate scan.
Resolve COUNT(column) argument through column_arg_index and decode only that aggregate column.
Increment COUNT(column) only for non-NULL values, matching SQL aggregate semantics.
Preserve COUNT(*) behavior and ORDER BY/LIMIT support from the existing fast path.
expected_impact: Extend SQL aggregate coverage for GROUP BY COUNT(column).
Avoid row materialization for simple grouped non-null counts.
risk_controls: Reject COUNT(DISTINCT column) and expression arguments as before.
Add SQL integration test with NULL values, aliases, COUNT(column), COUNT(*), ORDER BY alias.
